I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message. I confirmed I've noted the Tansley Parcel signed order form deadline as 25 August.

I also asked which year they mean. It's 14 October 2026 here, so 25 August this year has already passed. It may be 25 August 2027, or Pree may be recording a deadline that's already gone.

I didn't save a separate record. The brain stores channel messages automatically, so Pree's message is already there. I searched the brain and found no earlier deadline for this account to compare it with. That search ran in keyword-only mode, though, so I can't rule out an existing record worded differently.

The date is a signing date, which counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to discuss in the team channel.
